versions.changelog: Removed 'This is not a buy/sell/hold call.' from Decision section.
Example changed from (NASDAQ:GOOGL) to Google (NASDAQ:GOOGL) for clarity.
Reorder: Best For + What You Get moved before Install. Additional triggers now use - prefix (e.g. - Should I research...). Example changed from Pop Mart to (NASDAQ:GOOGL).

Install clarity: add --global/workspace/--force/update/verify commands. Trigger coverage: add Should I research..., Is...worth deeper research, Run Buffett-style research priority. Best For section. Feedback section improved. Safety line added. No buy/sell/hold, no price targets, no allocation language.
Moved Feedback section to the end of the page, after What This Will Not Do.
Added Feedback section with X contact.
Removed HTML comment block from Activation section — internal activation phrases no longer exposed as visible raw text on public page.

Simplified public page — shorter title, action-oriented intro, one primary activation trigger, renamed sections (Output Format → What You Get, Constraints → What This Will Not Do), removed Example section, added hidden activation phrases in HTML comment.
Simplified content — plain English, 3 checks, <30s output, no analyst memo style. LVMH example rewritten in plain language.

Title: What Buffett Would Do — Research Priority. Check First rewritten in plain English (removed ROIC above WACC jargon). LVMH example simplified to plain-English checks. All other improvements from v1.1.0 retained.

Simplified to 3-section action-first format. Slug renamed from wbwd-research-priority to buffett-do. Usable in under 30 seconds. Buffett principles now guide internally, not displayed as reading material.
